Description: That's it for today, Mark Clattenburg has blown his whistle and the game is over.
Stewart Downing (West Ham) takes a nice first touch to control a cross and fires in from the penalty spot, but his effort zooms just past the right post.
The ball goes behind for a corner. West Ham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
Another situation results in a direct free kick for West Ham.
Philippe Senderos (Fulham) commits a rough challenge and Mark Clattenburg blows his whistle for an infringement.
The resulting set piece from West Ham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Stewart Downing (West Ham). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. The ball goes out of play. West Ham are awarded a corner kick.
Fulham quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
Fulham take a short corner kick.
The ball is out of play. Fulham win a corner kick. Fulham take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

Fulham slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
West Ham hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player. Their movement didn't last so long as they lost the ball.
Total attempts – 30:11.
West Ham are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
Pajtim Kasami (Fulham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Damien Duff.

Alou Diarra (West Ham) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar. The ball crosses the byline and it's going to be a goal kick.
West Ham are awarded a mid-range free kick.
The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Fernando Amorebieta (Fulham).

Matthew Taylor (West Ham) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but David Stockdale was alert and the score remained the same.
The ratio of the ball possession is 68:32.
Damien Duff (Fulham) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.

A neat pass is well received by Darren Bent (Fulham), who is lurking on the edge of the box and produces a low drive directed towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
Mark Clattenburg couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Damien Duff (Fulham) and blew his whistle.
The manager has decided to substitute Adel Taarabt (Fulham) and he has been replaced by Darren Bent (Fulham).
What was Dimitar Berbatov (Fulham) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Modibo Maiga trots off the pitch and is replaced by Carlton Cole (West Ham).

2 - 1
Goal - 2:1! Scott Parker laid the ball off to Dimitar Berbatov (Fulham), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.

An unsuccessful long-range effort by Steve Sidwell (Fulham) after he collected a pass and unleashed a daisy-cutter. The ball was directed into the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper made an easy save.
Fulham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

Razvan Rat (West Ham) is penalised.
Razvan Rat (West Ham) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Fulham.

Steve Sidwell (Fulham) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. It will be a corner kick for Fulham.

Damien Duff (Fulham) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Jussi Jaaskelainen was alert and the score remains the same.
Here comes a substitution. Alexander Kacaniklic (Fulham) is brought on as a substitute for Kieran Richardson.
The manager has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Stewart Downing (West Ham) replacing Mohamed Diame (West Ham).
Damien Duff (Fulham) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar. It will be a goal kick.
Fulham work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
That was close. Adel Taarabt (Fulham) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post. The referee signals a corner kick to Fulham.
The resulting set piece from Fulham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
The ball is passed from one Fulham player to another, and the game isn't very exciting. Nothing lasts forever, though. They make a mistake, and possession is taken by the opponent.
Scott Parker (Fulham) tries his luck with a long-range effort after receiving a precise pass, but Jussi Jaaskelainen has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.
A quickly taken corner by Fulham.
John Arne Riise (Fulham) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Jussi Jaaskelainen makes a great save to stop his effort.
The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.

Fernando Amorebieta (Fulham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
Kevin Nolan (West Ham) is shown a red card by the referee for a horror tackle that simply has no place in football!
Modibo Maiga (West Ham) is caught in the offside trap after the defenders step up as one at the very right moment.

The game is interrupted. Matthew Taylor (West Ham) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. A free kick has been awarded to Fulham.
Adel Taarabt (Fulham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
Free kick awarded for an unfair challenge by Steve Sidwell (Fulham). He attempted to win the ball, but he was too aggressive according to the referee. A free kick is given to West Ham.

1 - 1
Steve Sidwell (Fulham) rises highest to meet the corner and his sweet header goes into the roof of the net. The goalkeeper was left flapping in the wind.
Corner kick. Damien Duff (Fulham) is ready to send the ball into the box.
Razvan Rat (West Ham) comes onto the pitch after Mark Noble signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
Mark Noble (West Ham) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.

The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Fulham. Fernando Amorebieta (Fulham) rose high to meet a perfectly taken corner kick and attempted to steer a fine header from inside the box towards the right side of the goal. Nobody knows what would have happened if one of the defending players hadn’t pulled off a brilliant intervention to block the effort.

A neat pass is well received by Dimitar Berbatov (Fulham), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
Adel Taarabt (Fulham) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Jussi Jaaskelainen easily deals with the threat.
A brilliant cross into the box finds Kevin Nolan (West Ham), who directs his header to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.
Kieran Richardson (Fulham) attempts to release Dimitar Berbatov (Fulham) with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
Adel Taarabt (Fulham) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.

Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Fulham are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
Jack Collison (West Ham) runs through on goal, but he is flagged for offside by the linesman after failing to beat the offside trap.
Modibo Maiga (West Ham) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
Scott Parker (Fulham) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
Adel Taarabt (Fulham) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
A player from West Ham takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Fulham.
Mohamed Diame (West Ham) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
The Fulham players find open spaces, and they are able to move the ball from one to another. But now comes an error, and they involuntarily pass the ball to their opponent.
West Ham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
Fernando Amorebieta (Fulham) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.

0 - 1
Mohamed Diame (West Ham) was a bit lucky to score a goal there. He got to the ball from the free kick and produced an accurate shot from just outside the penalty area into the bottom left corner.
Dimitar Berbatov (Fulham) is flagged for offside after the defenders execute the offside trap perfectly.

Excellent touch by Kevin Nolan (West Ham)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
Dimitar Berbatov (Fulham) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.

Modibo Maiga (West Ham) receives a reproachful look from his teammates after he attempted to surprise the goalkeeper with a shot from long distance. The ball flew far wide of the right post. It's a goal kick.
